name: kinetis/persistence
description: Request-scoped SQL transaction safety net and connection-pool factory for Kinetis — MySQL and Postgres via amphp/mysql and amphp/postgres.

suggest.ext-pgsql: Needed by amphp/postgres to actually connect — amphp/mysql is a pure-PHP wire-protocol client and needs no extension, but amphp/postgres wraps a real Postgres client library. pecl-pq is the alternative. Not hard-required here for the same reason amphp/postgres itself doesn't hard-require it: forcing this on MySQL-only or Postgres-less deployments would be overly restrictive.
